<!--
How API requests work:

- Bugs in the API (a documented call fails, a field is missing or has the wrong type) are fixed for free like any other bug. Please use a normal bug report for those.
- New calls and fields, and help wiring up a client, are built first for Developer Partner sponsors: https://github.com/sponsors/otherworld-dev
- Pull requests are welcome and get reviewed when time allows.
- Other requests stay open with the api-request label and may be picked up later, without a date.

Docs: https://budget.otherworld.dev/docs/api.html
-->
